fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) fell 8% amid weakness in AI and growth stocks, though HSBC upgraded from reduce to hold with $359 price target (slight upside from current), valuing it at $507 in a SpaceX acquisition scenario.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX (SPCX) fell 8% on news of $32B bond issuance (over 8% yield) for AI chip purchases; Rivian (RIVN) also fell 8% amid broad weakness; Applied Digital (APLD) plunged 18%, IREN 17%.
